supporting_pages.title: "Vector search for generative AI applications \_|\_ Memorystore for Redis\
evidence_snippets: This page describes how Memorystore for Redis supports storing and querying vector data for generative AI applications, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and LangChain, by using vector search capabilities.
